name: 小糸
text:
じゃああの時、どういう意味で『色づいてきた』って
言ってくれたんだろうって
trans:
I was just wondering, but what did she mean
by us were "being colored" back then.

name: 円香
text:
さあ
そこまで深く考えてないかもよ
trans:
Who knows. She probably didn't think that deeply
when she said that.

name: 円香
text:
気になるなら聞いてみたらいいんじゃない？
また一緒に仕事する機会があればだけど
trans:
If you're that bothered, why not just try asking?
That is, if we get a chance to work with her again.

name: 雛菜
text: 透先輩、今度はどっち行く～？
trans: Hey Toru-senpai, where to next～?

name: 透
trans: Hmー

name: 透
trans: That bend over there.

name: 雛菜
trans: To the right, huh～

name: 円香
text:
ストップ
会場から離れ過ぎる
trans:
Stop right there.
We're getting too far away from the venue.

name: 雛菜
trans: Where are we, actually～?

name: 円香
trans: You can look it up yourself.

name: 雛菜
trans: I don't know the name of the venue～

name: 円香
text: 連絡に書いてあったでしょ
trans: It was stated in our correspondence.

name: 小糸
text:
えっと……わたしたちがいた会場から
ずっと斜めに向かって……
trans:
Erm...... From where we came from, we've been
moving away in a diagonal direction from the venue.

name: 小糸
trans: And we've walked for about 20 minutes......!

name: 雛菜
text: じゃあ斜めに帰ればいいんだ～
trans: Then we can return by just walking back diagonally～

name: 円香
text:
……もともとはコンビニ行くって話だったのに
どうしてこうなった
trans:
......We just wanted to go to the convenience store.
How did we end up like this?

name: 透
text:
ふふっ、いいじゃん
歩きたかったし
trans:
Fufu, it's all good.
Besides, I wanted to take a walk.

name: 小糸
text:
わ、わたしも……半日乗り物で移動して
少し酔っちゃってたんだけど……
trans:
M-Me too...... I've been driven around for half a day
and was feeling a little motion sick.

name: 小糸
text:
歩いてたら
ちょっとよくなってきたよ……！
trans: I felt a little better after taking this walk......!

name: 雛菜
text: 雛菜、今日はもう何も乗りたくない～
trans:
Hinana don't wanna sit in any vehicle for the rest
of the day.

name: 透
trans: ......Ah, it's Producer.

name: 透
trans: ────Hellooー

name: プロデューサー
text:
『ごめん、お待たせ
打ち合わせが長引いた』
trans:
『Sorry for making you guys wait.
The meeting dragged on』

name: プロデューサー
text:
『コンビニは見つかったか？
離れてるなら迎えに行くよ』
trans:
『Have you found the convenience store?
If you're not there yet, I can come fetch you』

name: 円香
trans: ......What now?

name: 雛菜
text:
プロデューサー
コンビニ寄って～
trans:
Hey Producer,
drive here and bring us to the convenience store～

name: 円香
text: 今日はもう何も乗りたくないんじゃなかった？
trans:
Didn't you say you don't wanna sit in anything
for the rest of the day?

name: 雛菜
text:
だって今からコンビニまで行くの
大変でしょ～
trans:
But it's now become such a drag going to the
convenience store, isn't it～

name: 小糸
trans: T-Then......

name: 小糸
trans: Is there anything we can use as a landmark......

name: 雛菜
trans: There's nothing around here, huh～

name: 透
trans: Yeaー

name: 円香
text:
……だそうなので
位置情報を送ります
trans:
......Don't seem like there's any. I'll just send our
GPS coordinates.

name: プロデューサー
trans: 『Ah yes, I got it』

name: オフ
trans: off

name: off
trans: PLEASE

name: off
trans: PLEASE......

name: off
trans: A place

name: off
trans: Like

name: off
trans: In the middle of

name: off
text:
真ん中
みたいな場所
trans:
The sea,
At nowhere

name: プロデューサー
text:
見ての通り、歴史的文化財だから
ステージがある建物には電気が通ってないんだ
trans:
As you guys can see, there's no electricity going
through the building that houses the stage as this
place is a cultural heritage site.

name: スタッフ１
text:
────せーのっ……
ぶつけるなよ、ゆっくり行こう！
trans:
────One, and two...... Be careful to not break
anything, and take your time!

name: プロデューサー
text:
……今日はまだ設営してるところだから入れないけど
みんなには明日、そこで歌ってもらうことになる
trans:
......They're still setting up the stage, so you can't
enter yet, but you'll all be dancing atop of it
tomorrow.

name: プロデューサー
text:
少し特殊な環境だから
今のうちにわからないことはなんでも聞いてくれ
trans:
Since this is going to be a rather unique environment, 
fire away at me now if there's anything you don't
understand..

name: 一同
trans: Got itー

name: スタッフ１
text:
────オーライオーライ！
……よし、ストップ！
trans:
────Alright, alright!
......Okay, and stop!

name: スタッフ２
trans: Has the power generator arrived?

name: スタッフ１
trans: It just did!

name: スタッフ２
text: ああ、じゃあ配線手伝うよ
trans: Alrighty, then I'll help with the wiring.

name: 円香
text:
……ないもの。つまりライブで使うものは
ほぼ外付けになるんですね
trans:
......These are all stuff that weren't here. Meaning,
almost everything used for the live are brought in
from the outside.

name: 雛菜
text:
野外ステージとかで
ああいうの見た～
trans:
I've seen such arrangements for things like outdoor
stages～

name: プロデューサー
text:
ああ。だけどこっちの建物は電気が使えるから
控室もこっちにしてもらってるよ
trans:
Ah, yeah. But there's electricity running in this
building, so the waiting room will be set up here for
us too.

name: プロデューサー
text:
あ、でも敷地内での飲食は禁止されてるから
一旦は施設の外に出る必要があるんだけど……
trans:
Ah, but eating and drinking are prohibited on the
grounds, so you'll need to step out of the area for
meals......

name: 雛菜
trans: Huh～ What about during the performance～?

name: プロデューサー
text:
そこは、さすがに厳しいだろうと思って
出演中に水を飲む許可はもらっておいたよ
trans:
Yeah, I thought that'd be too tough too, so I got
permission for you guys to drink water during your 
performance.

name: 透
trans: Ohhー

name: 小糸
text: ありがとうございます……！
trans: Thank you so much......!

name: スタッフ３
text:
────プロデューサーさん
協会の方がいらっしゃったので……
trans:
────Hi Producer-san. The people from the 
association have arrived, so......

name: プロデューサー
text:
あ、はい
すぐに向かいます！
trans:
Ah, yes.
I'll head right over!

name: プロデューサー
text:
……ちょっと行ってくる
みんなはここでゆっくりしててくれ
trans:
......I'll be gone for a bit.
You guys can just relax over here.

name: 雛菜
trans: Let's take a sit for now～

name: スタッフ４
text:
────あ、あー
チェックチェック……
trans:
────Ah, ahhー
Mic test, mic test......

name: スタッフ４
trans: ......Is the mic coming through?

name: スタッフ５
text:
ちょっと待って
配線やり直す
trans:
Give me a sec.
I'll re-run the wiring.

name: 雛菜
trans: The wind, feels so good～

name: 透
trans: Mmー

name: 透
trans: *yawnー

name: 小糸
text: あ、明日もこんな天気だといいよね……！
trans:
Ah, it'd be great if the weather's like this tomorrow
too......!

name: 円香
text:
……晴れ所により曇り
だって
trans:
......Sunny, but cloudy in places,
the forecast says.

name: 雛菜
text: ライブするとこは、『所』に入るのかな～
trans:
I wonder if the live venue is gonna be one of those
"places"～

name: 円香
trans: Who knows.

name: 小糸
trans: I see......

name: 小糸
text:
────ライブの時は曇りじゃなくて
晴れになりますように……！
trans:
────Well, let's wish that it wouldn't be cloudy,
but sunny during our live......!

name: 透
trans: Please hear our wishesー

name: 円香
trans: Who are you asking.

name: 雛菜
trans: Aha～

name: 町の職員
trans: ────Erm, apologies but,

name: 町の職員
text:
みなさん、そこは座らないように
お願いできますか
trans: Can you guys not sit around there?

name: 町の職員
text:
そこ、一段高くなっているでしょう
お殿様が視察に来られた際に座る場所だったんですよ
trans:
That spot over there is raised, right?
That's where the lord of the land would sit
whenever he's here for an inpection.

name: 円香
trans: Let's move to the next room.

name: 透
trans: Sorry.

name: 町の職員
text:
こちらこそ、ご移動ありがとうございます
立て看板でも置いておきますね
trans:
We're sorry for the trouble too. Thank you so much
for moving. We'll also be putting up a sign board
about that here.

name: 町の職員
text: 明日はよろしくお願いします
trans: Looking forward to your stage tomorrow.

name: 小糸
trans: ......They really treasure this place, huh.

name: スタッフ２
text:
日が落ちてきた
暗くなる前に危ないとこ先やりたいな
trans:
The day's about over. I wanna get the dangerous
stuff out of the way before it darkens.

name: スタッフ１
text:
うん、とりあえず傷つけそうな作業だけ
先に終わらせよう
trans:
Yea, let's finish any work that might risk any damage
first.

name: 小糸
text: ……このお仕事をオファーしてもらえたのって……
trans: ......Being offered this job......

name: 小糸
text:
歴史を後世に受け継ぐために
ライブをきっかけにこの施設とか、歴史に紐づくことを
trans:
I've heard that its purpose was to inform the our
generation of this place and its connection to history,

name: 小糸
text:
わたしたちの世代の人たちに知ってもらいたいからって
聞いてたけど……
trans:
And using this live an opportunity to pass on history
to future descendants......

name: 小糸
text: こうして見てると、なんか……
trans: But looking at this, somehow it feels like......

name: 雛菜
text:
ん～
混ざってない、かも～
trans:
Hm～ 
Thing's aren't blendng well, maybe～

name: off
text: 塗りつぶしてるみたい
trans: Things are just getting painted over

name: 雛菜
text:
プロデューサー、まだこっち来れないから
先にチェックインしてていいって～
trans:
Producer's not going to come back for a while,
so we can check in to the hotel first, he says～

name: 小糸
text:
そっか……わたしたちだけで
先に向かってて正解だったね
trans:
I see......Looks like we were right to go
ahead on our own.

name: 円香
text:
……浅倉、ちゃんと前見て歩かないと
転ぶよ
trans:
......Asakura, you better look where you're walking,
or you'll trip.

name: 透
trans: Alrighー......t.

name: 小糸
trans: What are you looking at, Toru-chan.

name: 透
trans:
Eh?
Ahhー

name: 透
trans:
A path of light.
Over there.

name: 小糸
trans:
Ah......
You mean the clouds?

name: 透
trans: No, not that.

name: 円香
text:
雲の切れ間から出てる
光の柱のことじゃない
trans:
There's a pillar of light,
shooting through the clouds.

name: 雛菜
trans:
Ah～
You're talking about that, huh～

name: 小糸
trans: ......It's gonna get dark soon.

name: 雛菜
trans: Feels a little unnerving～ Doesn't it?

name: 円香
text: 道、またわかれてるけど
trans: The road's splitting again, though.

name: 透
text:
なんか
知ってるかも
trans:
Somehow,
I think I know.

name: 透
trans: The roads here.

name: 透
trans: Over there, it's like──

name: 透
trans: Glowing.

name: 透
text:
行ってみよ
あっち
trans:
Let's go.
Over there.

name: off
trans:
Laying footprints
on an

name: off
trans: Unknown path

name: off
trans: An adventure

name: off
trans: Begins
